subject: Fix duplicated code (#220)
reason: The change deletes dead code only: in SchemaManager::CreateIndexSchema, the removed `if (GetNumberOfIndexSchemas() >= max_indexes)` check was unreachable, because the preceding VMSDK_RETURN_IF_ERROR(vmsdk::VerifyRange(count + 1, nullopt, max_indexes)) fires on exactly the same condition (count >= max_indexes) and returns first. The surviving check and its error message are unchanged, so FT.CREATE at the max-indexes limit returns the identical error on both builds and no other code path is touched. A pure refactor with no behavior change needs no scenario; a compared sequence would have no repl
